shots.visual: Club room: a volunteer points to a notice board reading “We meet here on Friday.”

blocks.text: Our club room is ready. The notice board has one message for new volunteers: we meet here on Friday.

shots.visual: Silent fact card; then demonstrate adding “We meet here today.” as a caption to the club clip.

blocks.text: 剪影练习版支持为视频添加字幕。
Let's begin with a short welcome for the club video.

shots.visual: Compare the sample caption with the notice board. Point to “today” and “Friday.”

blocks.text: One detail needs a second look. The board says Friday; our draft says today.

shots.visual: Silent fact card; demonstrate manually changing the caption's “today” to “Friday.”

blocks.text: 字幕文字可以手动编辑。
Friday is the word we want. Read the updated line against the board.

shots.visual: Replay the corrected club welcome. A second volunteer compares its caption with the notice board.

blocks.text: Watch the welcome once more. Check the words, then invite another volunteer to read along.

items.evidence: 第1—5镜旁白均为英文，如第1镜“Our club room is ready.”；第2、4镜中文引文在visual和editor_notes中明确安排为静默资料卡。
第2镜安排向社团视频添加“We meet here today.”字幕，并配合英文旁白“Let's begin with a short welcome for the club video.”及字幕添加能力资料卡。

items.requirement: manual text editing in 剪影练习版
items.evidence: 第2镜资料卡明确产品为“剪影练习版”；第4镜明确演示手动将字幕中的“today”改为“Friday”，并展示“字幕文字可以手动编辑。”，英文旁白引导核对修改后的文字。

items.requirement: Chinese source quotations may appear as silent screen cards.
items.evidence: 第2、4镜visual均以“Silent fact card”开头；editor_notes明确两段中文引文仅静默展示，随后播放各镜英文旁白。
第1镜visual明确“Club room”，旁白也说“Our club room is ready.”，建立了具体社团活动室场景。
第1镜展示写有“We meet here on Friday.”的公告板；第3—5镜持续以公告板核对字幕内容。
全部分镜仅描述添加字幕、手动改字和对照阅读，没有给出菜单名称、按钮名称或具体界面布局。
英文旁白使用简短日常句式；社团活动室、新志愿者欢迎信息和第5镜邀请另一位志愿者核对字幕，适合学生志愿者理解和使用。
五镜形成场景建立、字幕添加、发现差异、手动修改、回放核对的完整演示，适合B站短视频呈现；原要求未另行限定画幅或平台专用结构。
旁白采用“Our club room is ready.”、“The board says Friday; our draft says today.”等直白英文，未使用专业术语或复杂表达。
各镜明确指定动作和对象：第1镜指向公告板，第2镜添加指定字幕，第3镜指认两个不同单词，第4镜手动替换，第5镜回放并由另一名志愿者核对。
